_comment: Manual Watchmode title ids for shows the automatic name+year match gets wrong. Use null to mark a show as not on Watchmode. Keys are CableEra show ids.

_notes.pokemon-black-white: Watchmode lists Black & White under the main Pokémon series
_notes.billy-and-mandy: Watchmode dates it 2001 (from Grim & Evil), outside the ±1 year match window
_notes.tom-and-jerry: Classic MGM shorts are listed as the 1965 Tom and Jerry TV package
_notes.looney-tunes: Classic theatrical shorts have no series entry, only DVD sets and later shows
